A concrete NRC shall be set, otherwise the DCM sends NRC 0x22 DCM_E_PENDING: The operation is not yet finished Description This function is a request from DCM to the IdsM to start the routine execution to request the current reporting mode of a specific Security Event ID. Available via IdsM_Cbk.h
